theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_bf_cone_ratio_reduction
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ) (a : Eucl N) (v : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N), (limsup (fun s : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * s) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) = 0 → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (η * (r * s) ^ (m + 1))) ∧ (limsup (fun s : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * s) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) = ⊤ → dimensionalUpperDensity (Measure.map (fun x : Eucl N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) x) : Eucl (m + 1))) μ).toOuterMeasure ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) univ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) a) : Eucl (m + 1)) = ⊤)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
